scope: foodtest AVD 上的云端 Android APK 回归；本轮只采集运行证据，不修改产品代码、schema 或架构

account_gate.physical_login: 真实填写 demo account 并点击登录后仍停留在 /access
account_gate.root_cause: src/lib/auth/server.ts sets secure=true whenever NODE_ENV=production, but the cloud authority is plain HTTP on an IP; Android WebView therefore does not persist ft_session

camera_entry.permission: pass: Android permission dialog appeared and While using the app was accepted
camera_entry.product_button: 立即拍照 opens com.google.android.providers.media.module PhotoPickerGetContentActivity on this AVD; picker exposes Photos/Albums/Browse and no direct camera option
camera_entry.avd_camera: pass: direct android.media.action.IMAGE_CAPTURE opens com.android.camera2 and shows a shutter surface

photo_recognition.isolation: after the auth red line, a one-time test session cookie was injected only to isolate the photo flow; this is not claimed as a full login-green run
photo_recognition.input: real food image public/images/nutrition/meal-hero.webp pushed to the AVD and selected through the Android Photo Picker
photo_recognition.recognition: real cloud AI response completed and produced 9 review items; first item 烤三文鱼, confidence 95%, 250 kcal, 24 g protein, 15 g fat
photo_recognition.review_surface: 9 / 9 items visible with editable food, meal type, portion and nutrition fields
photo_recognition.save: WebView POST /api/meals completed; authenticated readback returned HTTP 200 and 22 items for 2026-08-18, prior count 13 plus 9 newly saved items
photo_recognition.physical_confirmation: ADB coordinate taps did not activate the confirmation button reliably; CDP mouse dispatch was used as a fallback to complete this isolated save, so physical confirmation is not claimed green

green: AVD online and current cloud APK installed
photo selection, real recognition, review and cloud meal persistence work when authenticated
red: real Android login cannot persist the production Secure cookie over the current HTTP cloud URL
立即拍照 does not open the camera directly on this AVD
physical ADB confirmation tap is not reliable
conclusion.next_exact_action: open the smallest C-13-S3 fix slice for HTTP cookie policy and camera/file-input adapter behavior, then repeat clean-login and physical confirmation on the same foodtest AVD
